```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures")

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
# analytic sample
dem_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP")

analytic_ids <- dem_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

sound_analytic <- sound_events %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(analytic_ids, by = "id")

roundwise_analytic <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(analytic_ids, by = "id")
```


## Dyad button press descriptives
```{r}
dyad_press_summary <- sound_analytic %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_female = sum(responder_gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_male = sum(responder_gender == "Male", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_none = sum(responder_gender == "none", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_press = n_female + n_male,
    prop_female_given_press = if_else(
      n_press > 0,
      n_female / n_press,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dyad_press_descriptives_full <- dyad_press_summary %>%
  summarise(
    sample = "Full analytic sample",
    n_dyads = n(),

    mean_female_presses = mean(n_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_female_presses = sd(n_female, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_male_presses = mean(n_male, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_male_presses = sd(n_male, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_no_press_events = mean(n_none, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_no_press_events = sd(n_none, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_no_press_dyads = sum(n_press == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_no_press_dyads = mean(n_press == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

dyad_press_descriptives_full

dyad_press_summary_pressing_dyads <- dyad_press_summary %>%
  filter(n_press > 0)

dyad_press_descriptives_excluded_no_press <- dyad_press_summary_pressing_dyads %>%
  summarise(
    sample = "Sample excluding no-press dyads",
    n_dyads = n(),

    mean_female_presses = mean(n_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_female_presses = sd(n_female, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_male_presses = mean(n_male, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_male_presses = sd(n_male, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_no_press_events = mean(n_none, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_no_press_events = sd(n_none, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

dyad_press_descriptives_excluded_no_press

```


## Participant-level task performance and sound exposure
```{r}
study1_participant_performance <- roundwise_analytic %>%
  group_by(id, participant.code, gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matrices_seen = n(),
    n_matrices_completed = sum(completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_matrices_correct = sum(success, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_round_duration_secs = mean(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rounds_with_any_sound = sum(any_stimulus, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sum(n_sound_episodes > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

study1_participant_performance %>%
  summarise(
    mean_matrices_seen = mean(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_seen = sd(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_matrices_completed = mean(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_completed = sd(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_matrices_correct = mean(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_correct = sd(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_rounds_with_any_sound = mean(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_any_sound = sd(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = mean(n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sd(n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_round_duration_s = mean(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_round_duration_secs = sd(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

study1_participant_performance %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_matrices_seen = mean(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_seen = sd(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_matrices_completed = mean(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_completed = sd(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_matrices_correct = mean(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_correct = sd(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_rounds_with_any_sound = mean(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_any_sound = sd(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = mean(n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sd(n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_round_duration_s = mean(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_round_duration_secs = sd(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
## Paired gender comparisons of participant-level task performance
study1_performance_wide <- study1_participant_performance %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    gender,
    n_matrices_seen,
    n_matrices_completed,
    n_matrices_correct
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gender,
    values_from = c(
      n_matrices_seen,
      n_matrices_completed,
      n_matrices_correct
    )
  )

study1_difference_scores <- study1_performance_wide %>%
  transmute(
    id,
    matrices_seen_diff =
      n_matrices_seen_Female - n_matrices_seen_Male,
    matrices_answered_diff =
      n_matrices_completed_Female - n_matrices_completed_Male,
    matrices_correct_diff =
      n_matrices_correct_Female - n_matrices_correct_Male
  )

study1_difference_scores_long <- study1_difference_scores %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -id,
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "difference"
  )
```

```{r}
# Clear outcome labels
study1_difference_scores_long <-
  study1_difference_scores_long %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(
      outcome,
      levels = c(
        "matrices_seen_diff",
        "matrices_answered_diff",
        "matrices_correct_diff"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Matrices seen",
        "Matrices answered",
        "Matrices correct"
      )
    )
  )

p_study1_difference_boxplots <-
  ggplot(
    study1_difference_scores_long,
    aes(
      x = "",
      y = difference
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.45,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ outcome,
    scales = "free_y",
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Female − male difference"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s1_task_performance_difference_boxplots.png"
)

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_study1_difference_boxplots,
  width = 9,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)

p_study1_difference_qq <-
  ggplot(
    study1_difference_scores_long,
    aes(sample = difference)
  ) +
  stat_qq(
    alpha = 0.70,
    size = 1.6
  ) +
  stat_qq_line(
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ outcome,
    scales = "free",
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Theoretical quantiles",
    y = "Observed quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s1_task_performance_difference_qqplots.png"
)

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_study1_difference_qq,
  width = 9,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# Shapiro-Wilk tests of within-dyad difference scores

shapiro.test(
  study1_difference_scores$matrices_seen_diff
)

shapiro.test(
  study1_difference_scores$matrices_answered_diff
)

shapiro.test(
  study1_difference_scores$matrices_correct_diff
)
```

```{r}
## Primary paired-samples t-tests

t.test(
  study1_performance_wide$n_matrices_seen_Female,
  study1_performance_wide$n_matrices_seen_Male,
  paired = TRUE
)

t.test(
  study1_performance_wide$n_matrices_completed_Female,
  study1_performance_wide$n_matrices_completed_Male,
  paired = TRUE
)

t.test(
  study1_performance_wide$n_matrices_correct_Female,
  study1_performance_wide$n_matrices_correct_Male,
  paired = TRUE
)
```
